case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You describe rising alloy and labour costs, and we have taken that seriously. Our options give you a longer contract term and a clear structure to put in front of your pricing committee.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own purchase history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you will need to take this up internally, please bring Option A to the person who decides on pricing on your side. We would be glad to support that with whatever your approval needs.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. Regarding the alloy surcharge, our AS-14404 requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning recent drops do not reduce our current costs. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. While we cannot share our proprietary cost breakdown, we have reviewed the PPI-C2431 index data you provided and adjusted our offer accordingly.

Our updated offer is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We can support your requested 24-month term and 45-day payment terms at €5.32 per unit, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risks: a price of €5.32 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You say your alloy and labour costs are rising and that they stay as they are. Option A answers that with what matters to a group like yours: a longer contract term and a longer payment term, in a structure that is simple to put in front of a pricing committee.

Since your alloy is covered at fixed prices, we have not asked you to take a market fall into account. Our options carry no index clause, so there is nothing to track and nothing to reopen during the term.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives you the longest contract and the longest payment term of the three while the delivery record still has room to improve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.02; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.98; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We will gladly provide anything their approval needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the delivery record data you cited; however, this does not warrant a price reduction. We cannot offer fixed prices over a 24-month term and must insist on an AS-14404 index clause. 

Our current Angebot presents a price of €5.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.27 per unit, alongside Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership and serving your needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

You have asked twice for the index clause, and I understand it matters to you. Our options carry none, so the base price stays put and there is nothing for your pricing committee to track or reopen during the term.

Option A is the package we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.05; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.02; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.01; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Please take Option A to the person who decides on your side, as it is short and clear enough to be approved as it stands. If your approval needs anything more from us, tell me and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We are withdrawing from this negotiation. Our offer remains valid for 14 days. 

As your distributor, we always value our business relationship and look forward to continuing to serve you with our broad product range and dedicated service for your future requirements.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
